verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage documents a transaction-processing endpoint that creates a transaction and runs payment screening and transaction monitoring on it, and the published OpenAPI schema covers transaction resources, so the core ingestion capability exists. Customers can be referenced by an external identifier, but the evidence never shows counterparty fields on transactions or any guidance for validation errors or retrying rejected input. Missing for 10: documented customer and counterparty identifier fields in the transaction payload, validation error responses and rejected-input recovery guidance, hands-on corroboration.
